dedupe_keys.name: alesund norway modelling fire incident response times esgi 156 study group with alesund brannvesen

description: This case study models response times to fire incidents in Ålesund, Norway, from publicly available data, developed at the 156th European Study Group with Industry together with the local fire and rescue service, Ålesund Brannvesen. The authors, mathematicians attending the study group, published an extended 38-page report as a preprint, based on the study group report in the ECMI annual report for 2022. They build a response time model from station locations, the road network and incident data, investigate scenarios for station configuration, and take a first step towards interactive software that illustrates response times. Coverage is the Ålesund municipality area. The preprint is free under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike licence. Caveats: it is a short study-group exercise using public data only, results depend on assumed driving speeds and turnout times, and the interactive tool is a prototype. The study delivered scenario maps of response time across the area to support the fire service's planning. Simulation uses: a worked example of network-based response time modelling for emergency response and station location planning in a small city. Related records: England fire response times (data-england-fire-incident-response-times) and London Fire Brigade incident records (data-london-fire-brigade-incident-records) cover comparable questions for England.
